Ice Cream Taffy
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, January 2, 2010 - 12:34am

Ingredients




3 cups sugar
1 cup boiling water
4 tablespoons white corn syrup
2 tablespoons butter
2 tablespoons vinegar
Flavoring

Preparation

1 In a saucepan, mix sugar, water, syrup, butter and vinegar together. Wipe down sides of pan. Cover and bring slowly to boiling point. Remove cover and cook to 258 degrees. Cool on buttered marble slab. Turn in edges to center with fork so they won't get hard. When cool enough to handle, add flavoring and pull. Keep pulling until it gets too hard, then stretch out on waxed paper.
